user.title: Add a fishing location
user.description: Pick the spot you fish from, then a point a few kilometres offshore for the wave model (requesting marine data on land can snap to an unusable grid cell). Coast bearing points from the shore straight out to sea — 270° for a west-facing Perth beach. The fishing style reshapes how swell, wind and tide are scored — pick what you mostly target.

abort.already_configured: A fishing location with these coordinates is already set up.

init.title: Fishing Forecast tuning
init.description: The fishing style sets how much swell, wind, tide and time-of-day matter. Leave the preferred hours blank to consider the whole day.

options.calm_water: Calm water — herring, whiting, squid, garfish
options.rock_snapper: Rock wall / groyne — pink snapper, mulloway, after storms
options.estuary_marina: Inside the marina / estuary — mulloway, bream (sheltered)
